title: Life saving for those who wants to build a new habit!
body:
Life saving for those who wants to build a new habit! Ive been looking for apps; free, simple and details. There some who are free and simple but they dont show the trends. Then, i stumbled upon apps free, show trends but not user friendly. And then i found this!!

Too bad it’s limited only to 3 habits for free user. Ive never bought an app before, But you sway me! Im considering to buy this app so i can build & track my habits without limit. Thank you developer!
